summary: Ericsson filed a 6-K announcing an orderly CEO succession: Per Narvinger appointed President and CEO effective October 1, 2026, succeeding Börje Ekholm, who steps down on September 30, 2026 and will serve as executive advisor through June 15, 2027. The transition is described as well-prepared by the Board as part of governance planning. No price, premium, or shareholder vote. This is a planned leadership change, not a contested departure. Watch for strategy continuity and any future M&A signals under new leadership.
